metadata.description: Sereneco agent plugins, skills and hooks for review discipline, session continuity and security guardrails.

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adversarial code, architecture and specification review using OpenAI Codex as a second hostile reviewer, with PreToolUse hooks enforcing write-path authorisation, refutation-appendix ingestion and rubric integrity.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write and resume HANDOFF.md so work survives context limits, /clear and session boundaries without the user re-explaining the task.

plugins.name: guard-hooks
plugins.description: Security guardrails as hooks: block dangerous shell commands, writes to credential files and system paths, and secrets in file content; refuse to read a file holding a live credential or to print a credential-bearing environment variable; pre-approve provably-safe rm; enforce the project's package manager; warn on destructive git operations; alarm if a credential reaches the transcript anyway.
